title: Science Centres for Kids: Hands-On Days Out
description: Hands-on science centres for kids and teens in the UK, Europe and the US: Eureka!, Cité des Sciences, NEMO, the Exploratorium and free galleries.
h1: Science centres for kids: hands-on days out
intro: Press the buttons, pull the levers, make a mess. Science centres are made for curious kids, and they’re brilliant on rainy days.

image.alt: A boy leaning on the glass of an aquarium full of fish

cardText: Eureka!, NEMO, the Exploratorium and more.

blocks.title: Scout’s science tip
blocks.text: Let kids lead. The exhibit they spend 20 minutes on is the win, even if you don’t see everything.
points: Under-7s: look for dedicated early-years areas

sections.html:
• Eureka! The National Children’s Museum, Halifax: built for under-11s.
  • Science Museum, London: free general admission, with some paid interactive galleries.
  • National Museum of Scotland: free, with hands-on science and tech galleries.

• Cité des Sciences, Paris, with its children’s area.
  • NEMO, Amsterdam: hands-on science in a striking green building.
  • Exploratorium, San Francisco: hundreds of interactive exhibits.
See museums and science and space days out.

faqs.q: What is a good science museum for toddlers?
faqs.a: Look for dedicated early-years areas, such as those at Eureka! in Halifax, or the children’s area at Cité des Sciences in Paris.
